notes: ADR-0235 pull of the 300 next-most option-active US stocks, mirroring option-universe-100 (same window, DTE 30-45, inactive contracts, daily trade bars, indicative feed). The symbol list is read from $INDEX_OPTIONS_ROOT/configs/option_universe_300.json (written by run-option-universe-300-rank.json), never typed here; symbols_file must be absolute after $VAR expansion (export INDEX_OPTIONS_ROOT=<this child's root>) and symbols_sha256 pins the file, so a regenerated ranking refuses until the hash is updated deliberately. Store root: /home/russell/data/stock_options/option-universe-300. Run with the Alpaca keys and INDEX_OPTIONS_ROOT exported: python -m dskit.onboarding init --root ROOT; register-source options --catalog-source options --connector dskit.onboarding.libs.alpaca:AlpacaOptionFetchConnector --config @configs/source-option-universe-300.json --activate --root ROOT; acquire --source options --stream contracts --mode backfill --root ROOT; then --stream bars (rerun the same command to resume).
